text: Chivas Regal has been part of Pernod Ricard since 2001 and belongs to Chivas Brothers, Pernod Ricard's Scotch whisky business. Pernod Ricard's shares are listed on Euronext Paris (code RI).
short: Chivas Regal has been part of Pernod Ricard since 2001.
